create_multiagent_gridworld_env: create a MultiGridEnv with N agents, competitive or non-competitive mode, and a fixed grid size
run_multiagent_episode: run a multi-agent gridworld episode by calling reset then step with an array of actions per agent
place_agents_and_objects: place agents and objects like doors, keys, and goals at random or specific positions in the grid
render_multiagent_grid: render the multi-agent gridworld environment with per-agent visibility masks and agent color highlighting
decode_grid_encoding: decode a numpy array grid encoding back into a Grid object with a visibility mask using Grid.decode
